## Verifiable Project Portfolio

### 1. GEHU Connect (Sole Flagship Campus Application)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/gehu-connect/
- Type: Deployed Mobile Application (Android, iOS)
- Status: Deployed and used by roughly 1,000 students at Graphic Era Hill University
- Architecture:
  - Client: React Native with Expo Router, Redux Toolkit Query, SecureStore, FlashList, STOMP WebSockets
  - Backend API: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.5.9 REST API with JPA/PostgreSQL, JWT auth, and WebSocketAuthInterceptor
  - Caching: L1 Caffeine (5 min TTL) + L2 Redis (30 min TTL) layered cache with ReentrantLock stampede protection
  - Media Storage: Presigned Cloudflare R2 PUT uploads via AWS SDK S3Presigner (enforced limits: 25 MB image/doc, 50 MB video, 100 MB batch)

### 2. Netwich (Completed & Released Native macOS Utility)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/netwich/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Netwich
- Type: Native Desktop Utility (macOS 14 or later)
- Status: Completed and released (v0.1.0 DMG)
- Stack: Swift 6 toolchain, SwiftUI, Darwin SOCKS5 proxy, `IP_BOUND_IF`, Browser Bridge extension
- Highlights: Local SOCKS5 relay (`127.0.0.1:1080`), weighted least-connections scheduler, EWMA RTT/throughput scoring, parallel byte-range download engine, proxy state snapshotting, and sanitized filename handling. Honest scope: single TCP stream speed does not exceed one interface; multi-link gains apply to multi-flow and chunked workloads.

### 3. ARANYA (In-Progress Prototype)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/aranya/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Project-Aranya
- Prototype: https://project-aranya.vercel.app
- Stack: CesiumJS 1.124, Vite, JavaScript, Mapbox Vector Tiles, NASA GIBS MODIS NDVI overlay
- Pilot: Rajaji and Corbett National Park corridors in Uttarakhand, India

### 4. ORVESS-PAT (In-Progress Simulation Workbench)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/orvess-pat/
- Focus: Python 3.10+ and PySide6 simulation workbench for SIH26169 FSOC coarse pointing, acquisition, and tracking (640x480 FPA optics model, sub-pixel centroiding, observation quality `q_t`, Adaptive-R EKF).

### 5. Meghavyuha (In-Progress SIH 2026 Prototype)
- Detail Page: https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/meghavyuha/
- Deployment: https://meghavyuha.vercel.app
- Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, deck.gl, MapLibre GL, Recharts
- Scope: Smart India Hackathon 2026 (PS SIH26080, Team Against The Odds 149284) probabilistic monsoon rainfall post-processing prototype with empirical Error Atlas evidence tracing. Research prototype, not a replacement for IMD/NCMRWF warnings.
